scope: V4 Phase 1 only; no SupCon/triplet/OE/new-hard training/fullFT/production replacement
baseline: Frozen production V3 + exact deployed detector, 128 RGB input
benchmark: New semantic Unicode identities not anywhere in V3 hard train/val/test; curated 2D/3D cartoon art. Build before any evaluation; grouped independence and exact pixel audit against all project data. Limited coverage, not plush/photo/commercial cartoon benchmark.

experiments.name: mobilenet_frozen
experiments.train: projection128 + head; official frozen backbone; CE only ID train

experiments.name: mobilenet_partial_ft
experiments.train: initialize frozen best; unfreeze last 3 backbone blocks; frozen BN stays eval; CE only ID train

experiments.name: mobilenet_frozen_128_control
experiments.train: same Frozen protocol; size-matched representation control

checkpoint_selection: ID val accuracy then CE loss; test never read
calibration: Re-fit shared LedoitWolf on ID train, raw vs L2. Original 73 ID +150 Easy +70 old Hard val only. T=.5/1/2/5, OR/AND ablations. >=95% ID TAR; minimize worst-domain FAR then pooled FAR and preserve correct ID. New benchmark unavailable to fitting/calibration.
candidate_selection: Validation only: eligible val closed ID acc within 3pp V3; >=95% val ID TAR. Lowest worst easy/hard val FAR. Pick exactly one MobileNet for ONNX before test. Export even if worse; artifacts/v4 only.
evaluation: Same original73 ID,150 Easy and all new benchmark images for every model. Frozen calibration first; score test once after all selection locked. Keep old149 Hard as historical only.
success_rule: Recommend replacement only if Hard FAR reduces >=10 percentage points and paired identity-cluster bootstrap 95% CI improvement excludes0; ID end-to-end drop <=3pp, ID FRR increase <=3pp, Easy FAR increase <=3pp. Test is for reporting/adoption decision, never threshold tuning.
full_ft: N/A; optional not needed for core comparison
limitation: V3 historically received OE; new MobileNets use ID CE only. Primary MobileNet224 vs V3_128 includes resolution confound; extra Frozen128 control addresses resolution but not objective/history. This cannot establish single-factor causality.
